notes.content: -Fixed a bug where some flashback sequences would trigger another event instead and break the game

notes.title: Henteria Chronicles: The Peacekeepers is now out in Early Access!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]I deeply thank you for taking an interest in my humble game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527670/24316edecef00f509bfde3b2e8d281c02eb6e471.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]I know that RPGMaker games tend to have a bad reputation, but I can assure you that thousands upon thousands of hours have been poured into mine, and a lot of attention and care have been put into the tiniest of details.[/p][p][/p][p]At the time of this message, the game is already several hours long, with over 60 spicy scenes, so don't expect a game you can finish in a couple minutes. Still, if that doesn't scare you, then hop in for the ride~[/p][p][/p][p]It's going to be... a wild one, I'd say.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527670/0ba5974f7c6095eccd425dac7612e5fa40e85855.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Leave a review, let me know what you've thought of the game, share your feedback, report bugs, it always helps![/p][p][/p][p]From now on, I intend on updating the game every ~3 months, until it is finished and ready for a full release.[/p][p][/p][p]Have a nice day![/p][p][/p][p]-The dev, N_Taii[/p]
